_about: Universal constants given to closed-form candidates as U[...] and listed in the prompt. A universal constant has the same value for every building and weather, so writing it into a formula does not make the model building-specific. Per-building values (facade and partition conductivity, density and specific heat, slab density, occupants per room, outdoor film coefficient) are NOT here: formulas must infer them from the history buffer. Review this file once before a real run and set _reviewed to true (decision: review the constants once before they go into the prompt).

CELL.what: grid cell side of floor_plan / zone_map

T0.what: starting temperature of every cell (air, walls, slab)

OCC_W.what: heat given to the room by one occupant
